title: Omamori mod manifest
description: canonical mod.json form for an Omamori mod.

id.description: Unique id, used by other mods dependencies. Reverse domain style is recommended, e.g. "yourname.coolmod".

version.description: Semantic version of the mod. Missing minor/patch count as 0 and a leading v is allowed.

entry.description: The mod's assembly, relative to the mod folder.

apiVersion.description: The Omamori API version the mod was built against, major.minor. Loads on any Omamori with the same major and an equal or higher minor.

capabilities.description: What the mod does, shown to users before install. Gameplay affecting mods are not allowed.

hooks.description: Hooks the mod uses. A required hook that's unavailable skips the mod, an optional one only skips what uses it. Undeclared hooks count as optional.

dependencies.description: Other mods this one needs. They always load first.

minVersion.description: Lowest accepted version. A prerelease sorts before its release, so 1.0.0-beta does not satisfy 1.0.0.

optional.description: Optional dependencies load first when present, the mod loads without them otherwise.
